blind.description: A traditional wooden church pew or choir bench featuring a long plank seat, a paneled backrest with recessed vertical sections, a bottom foot/support rail, and ornate side end-caps topped with carved fleur-de-lis finials. Textures are a warm, polished medium-brown wood with stylized painted bevels and shading.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal rectangular strip showing the top rail and seat plank, flanked by decorative finial caps on either end.
blind.height_vs_figure: The pew stands about 60% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.5 to 4 ft tall at the finials), and its length is roughly equal to the height of the figure (around 5.5 to 6 ft wide).

notes: Height is slightly taller than catalog expectation due to carved finials
